note: Gun cards (studio background and transparent), web GLBs, attachment pictures, stats and licences of the 41 guns of the Desert Fortress UE build.
glb_axes: glTF: -X = muzzle (barrel tip at the bounding box min X), +Y = up, +Z = the gun's left side, metres (real size), origin = bounding box centre; unskinned, one mesh. A default glTF camera (looking down -Z) sees the left side, muzzle to the left; turn 180 deg about +Y for the card view (right side, muzzle to the right)
sockets_note: Per gun 'sockets' {optic, muzzle, mag}: [x, y, z] in metres in that gun's GLB space (same axes and origin as its vertices; the GLBs have the muzzle at -X, see glb_axes). Source: the UE weapon mesh sockets of the game build, moved the way the GLB was built: glb = [-(ue.y - c.y), ue.z - c.z, ue.x - c.x] / 100, c = centre of the UE mesh bounds (= the GLB bounding box centre; sizes match to 0.1 mm). muzzle = UE socket 'Muzzle' (muzzle flash point = barrel tip, at the bounding box min X). mag = UE socket 'Mag' (magazine bone pivot: top of the magazine, in the magwell; on the DP-27 the pan on top); null = no detachable magazine (p90, m1014, m24, lever, mosin, revolver, ssg69). optic = mount base point on the receiver / rail top, on the in-game sight line (UE sockets Sight_Rear -> Sight_Front, also given as sight_line), 25 % of the way from the rear sight to the front sight (mosin, ssg69, svd: over the receiver); its height is the top surface of the GLB there (25th percentile of a 6 cm strip, so sight posts do not count); on guns with a carry handle or built-in sight (famas, g36, p90, m16a4, awm) it is the top of that. null = no optic slot in the game (dp27). The game has no optic socket of its own (attachments change stats only), so this point is derived. optic_rail_offset = how far the in-game iron sight line runs above the optic point [m] (0 when a built-in sight is taller): put a scope's mount base on 'optic' for a low mount, or raise it by optic_rail_offset to keep the game's aim line and clear the iron sights. dual_beretta: the sockets of the upper pistol; the second pistol = the same points + second_pistol_offset.
card_view: right side of the gun, muzzle to the right, camera 20 deg toward the muzzle and 9 deg above, 70 mm lens
